name: Dex Coleman
want: get to his sister's last known location in the next county
secret: Two days ago something scratched his forearm during a supply run. He wrapped it and tells himself it was broken glass.
voice: Loud, quick, military slang, jokes when scared.
description: Army reserve, two weekends a month, until the world ended. Brave, loud and loyal; the one who stands watch without being asked.
appearance: Broad-shouldered with a buzz cut and an old unit T-shirt, a shotgun on a sling and dirt ground into his boots.

agenda.goal: hide how bad the wound is getting
steps: rewraps his forearm alone and swallows the last painkillers
scouts the route toward the county line from the roof

steps.text: comes to Jordan asking to take the pickup out alone
